items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Where does that he live, this Freddie Lucius? I don't know where he lives but he's a, he's a bobertender at St. Peter in Durginville.

ctx.x: Fred knows a lot of these boys and we never hear.

I just forgot a lot of them. Fredolution? Fredolution, now he's a blues singer. That's what he is, he's a blues singer, he's a good blues singer too. I was at his place yesterday and I said, we've got to get together and I want to take you to a friend of mine's house and I said, we're going to go there one day and just sit down and play a couple of numbers, you know what I mean? I just want him to hear you sing the blues. And this other boy, Paul, well he's a sentimental singer, he's a good singer too. Oh there's…
I was in back but they didn't, there was a sign, ring bell. I was back in back.
